title: Add Language Selector
content: Create language picker. Trigger: button with current language flag and name, dropdown arrow. Dropdown: absolute bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border py-2 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto. Language item: px-4 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center gap-3, flag icon, language name in both native and English. Selected: checkmark icon. Search: optional search input at top for many languages.

variants.detailed: Create language picker. Trigger: button with current language flag and name, dropdown arrow. Dropdown: absolute bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border py-2 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto. Language item: px-4 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100 flex items-center gap-3, flag icon, language name in both native and English. Selected: checkmark icon. Search: optional search input at top for many languages.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive locale selector. Trigger variants: dropdown button, icon-only button (for headers), inline select, footer link format. Display options: flag + native name, flag + English name, native name only (flags can be controversial). Language list: ISO language codes, native language names, completion percentage for partial translations. Grouping: popular/common languages at top, then alphabetical, or by region. Search: filter languages by name (in any language), keyboard navigation through filtered results. Selection: current language highlighted, persist choice in cookie/localStorage and user preferences. URL strategy: subdomain (en.site.com), path prefix (/en/page), query param (?lang=en), or domain per region. Detection: auto-detect from browser language, suggest switch if different from current. RTL support: automatically switch to RTL layout for Arabic, Hebrew, etc. Currency/region: optional region selector alongside language (affects currency, date format). Incomplete translations: warning badge if language has incomplete translations, fallback language display. Keyboard shortcut: configurable shortcut to open language selector. Flags: use flag icons carefully, some users find them inaccurate (e.g., UK flag for English used by US users). Accessibility: proper button/menu semantics, language names in native script, live region announcement on change.
